source: Trimmed to what scripts/sync/sync-operator-costs.mjs reads: records from arkpedia-data source/data at 7f47095a (the costs as the wiki import left them, before the operator-costs stage), tables from ArknightsAssets/ArknightsGamedata en at 56aee3d6c5a29c3a0d192456d70d14252cbb0804 and Kengxxiao/ArknightsGameData zh_CN at a550f5e048bb94e7cdefc6eb97a4091f0c4c7add, and data/material-names.json at the same data commit.

materialNames.about: English names for materials the CN client has and the EN client does not have yet, keyed by game item id. scripts/lib/material-items.mjs reads it; once the EN client ships an id, its own name wins and the builders report the entry as spent.

recommendation.explanation: This skill has aged very well. Fantastic against high DEF enemies due to her uncapped scaling in damage.
